card.name: Linking words just before statin names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (and, with, of, taking, e.g.,) right before a statin drug name such as simvastatin, atorvastatin or lovastatin is expected, in statin interaction and warning text.

modes.label: After combination partner
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'with' after a drug paired with a statin, just before the statin name.

modes.label: In example lists
modes.description: Punctuation like 'e.g.,' or a colon that opens a list of statins or lipid drugs.
modes.example: ergotamine, methylergonovine Herbal Products: St. John's wort ( Hypericum perforatum ) Lipid-modifying Agents<<:>> lomitapide, lovastatin

modes.label: Patients taking statins
modes.description: A verb or preposition leading into a statin name in safety statements.
modes.example: simvastatin tablet, and thereafter when clinically indicated. There have been rare postmarketing reports of fatal and non-fatal hepatic failure in patients<< taking>> statins, including simvastatin

card.writes: It pushes the model toward sterol- and statin-like word starts such as ster and sterol.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a statin name, when the text is about to name a cholesterol drug.
